layer_purpose: Lightweight AI-ready summaries with explicit provenance; does not replace VNSTOCK source data.

files.name: summary_manifest.json
files.purpose: Inventory and governance contract for the summary layer.
files.update_rule: Update whenever a summary file is added or regenerated.

files.name: dataset_coverage_summary.json
files.generated_from: Phase 1 observed counts and Phase 1.5 registry
files.update_rule: Regenerate after source pipeline refresh or coverage audit.

files.name: ticker_coverage_summary.json
files.purpose: Aggregate ticker coverage and per-ticker schema contract.
files.update_rule: Replace or supplement with enumerated records only after approved safe builder.

files.name: data_freshness_summary.json
files.purpose: Observed latest dates and suitability warnings.
files.update_rule: Regenerate from source MAX date/update fields before live use.
limitations: No fresh MAX query or filesystem mtime scan.

files.name: financial_coverage_summary.json
files.purpose: Describe raw and processed BCTC coverage and gaps.
files.update_rule: Regenerate after quarterly BCTC refresh/processor run.
limitations: No per-report recount or field missingness scan.

files.name: price_coverage_summary.json
files.purpose: Describe OHLCV range, fields and usage risks.
files.update_rule: Regenerate after OHLCV update and adjustment audit.

files.name: ai_readiness_score.json
files.purpose: Dataset documentation-readiness scores; not investment scores.
limitations: Heuristic readiness estimate, not fresh empirical audit.

files.name: summary_layer_readme.md
files.purpose: Usage guide and provenance policy for summary files.
files.update_rule: Update with summary layer contract changes.
limitations: Guidance does not enforce validation automatically.
All observed values inherit Phase 1 discovery cutoff unless stated otherwise.
